name: Side Sit Hair Touch Point
bodyPosition: Seated on the floor with torso slightly twisted toward camera. Weight on the right hip and right thigh. Left leg folded underneath, right leg extended forward and slightly bent at the knee.

legs.rightLeg: Extended forward, knee softly bent, foot pointed and wearing black strappy high-heel sandal
legs.leftLeg: Folded under the body, knee pointing outward, foot also in black strappy high-heel sandal

torso: Upright with a slight arch in the lower back. Shoulders relaxed and open.

arms.leftArm: Raised, hand running through long dark hair, elbow bent
arms.rightArm: Extended downward and slightly forward, index finger pointing toward the floor

hands.rightHand: Index finger extended, other fingers relaxed

head: Turned toward camera, chin slightly down
expression: Soft smile, lips parted, playful and inviting
